subject: Middle School Lottery Process Update
overview: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent presented the 2024-2025 middle school lottery process, which was established to address racial and socioeconomic imbalances between the Andrews and McGlynn schools. The session detailed the selection criteria, updated sibling preference rules, and the timeline for assigning incoming fifth-grade students to their respective middle schools.

items.title: Introductions and Background of the Lottery Process
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent and district administrators explained that the lottery system was initiated in 2019 at the direction of the Medford School Committee to correct significant racial and socioeconomic discrepancies between the two middle schools. Current data indicates that both schools now closely reflect the overall diversity of the Medford Public Schools and maintain nearly equal enrollment numbers.

items.title: Lottery Selection Criteria and Sibling Preference
items.summary: Students are assigned based on a 50/50 split from each elementary school, though placements for specialized programs such as newcomer English Learner or specific Special Education programs take precedence over the lottery. Sibling preference is available for families with older siblings who will still be enrolled at the middle school in August 2024, but the district has discontinued sibling preference for families with younger siblings at the McGlynn Elementary School to maintain balance.

items.title: Enrollment Balance and English Learner Buffer Seats
items.summary: To manage rolling admissions and maintain balanced class sizes, the district reserves 12 buffer seats at the McGlynn Middle School specifically for newcomer English Learner students. This strategy allows the district to accommodate students who arrive throughout the school year without causing an enrollment imbalance between the two facilities.

items.title: Lottery Timeline and Assignment Dates
items.summary: Sibling opt-in forms are due by March 29, with student lottery numbers distributed on April 4 and the official drawing results posted on April 9. Assignment letters will be sent on April 24, followed by open houses at the McGlynn Middle School on May 2 and the Andrews Middle School on May 6.

items.title: Public Q&A and School Facilities
items.summary: Administrators clarified that both schools offer aligned curricula, including French and Spanish instruction, and that students from both schools may participate together in sports and extracurricular clubs. In response to parent inquiries, the Superintendent confirmed that both buildings are air-conditioned and that special education teams coordinate closely during the transition from elementary to middle school.
